# Google Material Symbols — Outlined

Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons, Google LLC.
Icon browser: https://fonts.google.com/icons

Selected `symbols/web/<icon>/materialsymbolsoutlined/<icon>_24px.svg` files, variant **Outlined, Fill 0, Weight 400, Grade 0, Optical size 24**. The 960-unit SVG geometries are transformed to static 24×24 Avalonia StreamGeometry resources in `src/ui/Arssyut.UI/Design/MaterialSymbolsCapture.axaml` and `MaterialSymbolsActions.axaml`. No icon fonts, extra packages, or network calls during use.
